about.label: About me
about.heading: Never just one thing.
about.body:
I'm Sara. I'm 22, I'm from Aveiro, and I'm building something, I don't know exactly what yet, but I know it's going to be big.

I love creating. Turning ideas into real things, videos, websites, campaigns, or just an idea that wouldn't leave my head until I made it exist.

I'm scared of being mediocre. Of one day looking back and realising I stayed comfortable when I could have taken more risks. That fear is what keeps me going.

@sarapresaa was born from that, from the need to document, to be honest, to show that the path isn't linear and that's okay.

I'm an IT student, content creator, digital marketing and web enthusiast, and I genuinely believe creativity and technology together are the most powerful combination there is.

timeline.label: My journey
timeline.heading: Where I came from. Where I'm going.

items.title: 10 years at the Conservatory
items.description: I studied organ and classical singing at the Aveiro Music Conservatory alongside school. For 10 years I learned that discipline, patience and creativity always go hand in hand.

items.title: First professional experiences
items.description: I worked at Zara (Inditex), a call centre and my family's hair salon. I learned to deal with people, pressure and completely different environments. Nothing was wasted.

items.title: Information Technology, ESTGA
items.description: I started my IT degree at the University of Aveiro. I discovered web development, UI/UX, databases, digital marketing. I realised this is where everything made sense.

items.title: @sarapresaa was born
items.description: I created my personal brand and started documenting the journey publicly. Content, UGC, strategy and branding, all alongside university. The real-time laboratory.

items.title: Building
items.description: Another year of my degree. Developing this site, preparing for my internship, growing @sarapresaa and figuring out where I want to go. I don't know everything yet, and that's okay.

items.title: What comes next
items.description: A curricular internship at a company that unites technology and creativity. And then? My own digital ecosystem to help other creators build brands with real impact.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How I handle the personal data collected on this site, including the newsletter.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: I'm Sara Presa, from Aveiro, Portugal, and I'm the controller of the personal data collected on this site.

sections.title: What data I collect and why
paragraphs: I only collect the data I need, and only when you give it to me.
items: Newsletter: your email and the site language you subscribed in, to send you the newsletter. The legal basis is your consent, which you give when you subscribe and confirm again through the link I email you.
Messages: if you write to info@sarapresaa.pt or through the contact form, I use your name, your email and your message only to reply to you.
Technical logs: the hosting service may keep data such as your IP address for a short time, to keep the site secure and working.

sections.title: Who I share data with
paragraphs: I use two services that process data on my behalf. I don't sell or give your data to anyone else.
items: Resend: stores the newsletter list and sends the emails, including contact form messages.

sections.title: Transfers outside the European Union
paragraphs: These services may process data outside the European Economic Area, notably in the United States, with the safeguards required by the GDPR.

sections.title: How long I keep data
paragraphs: Your email stays on the newsletter list until you unsubscribe. You can unsubscribe at any time with the link at the bottom of every issue of the newsletter, and if you want I'll delete all your data too. I keep the messages you send me only as long as needed to reply.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site doesn't use advertising, analytics or social media cookies. It only stores one functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) with the language you chose, to show the site in the right language. It isn't used to track you.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing, to ask for portability, and to withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting what was done before. You can also lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (cnpd.pt).
